analysis.reasonEn: Daily RSI at 33.3 entering oversold territory, attempting a rebound after 5 consecutive days of decline. However, MACD histogram continues to worsen, and the volume ratio (0.88 vs 5-day average) is subdued, lowering confidence in a trend reversal. ADX at 26.5 indicates a clear trend forming, but -DI remains above +DI, suggesting downward pressure. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive trading day.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 89,725) above SMA5 (KRW 88,437), below SMA20 (KRW 102,871) and SMA50 (KRW 104,862): short-term rebound attempt, below mid-term trend.
· Below SMA100 (KRW 113,980) and SMA200 (KRW 99,667): mid-to-long-term weak trend maintained.
· 52-week position (48.4%) + current price level is high relative to 52-week low (KRW 30,840), low relative to high (KRW 152,455).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.3→33.3) + entering oversold territory + signal of easing downward pressure.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1788.6755→-2048.7272) + diagnosis of worsening + weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 83,473) + band width at 37.71% is wide.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 82,710) + based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance (KRW 95,720) + approaching Pivot PP (KRW 96,553).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low not formed, potential for sideways) + trend reversal uncertainty.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.88x) + subdued confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (rebound attempt during downtrend) + conditions for entry/wait-and-see: confirmation of further RSI rise and MACD improvement.
